description: How to verify a milestone's visual exit criterion for dev-companion: capture the running game's own framebuffer with the in-process `shotcap` tool, then ask a vision model what is actually on screen via scripts/visual-check.py. Use whenever a milestone's exit criterion describes something a human must SEE (a progress bar moving, a HUD element appearing, a character animating, art looking finished), or when a milestone log records a visual check as unverified.
should_trigger: TODO: a request that must invoke visual-verification
should_not_trigger: TODO: a nearby request that must NOT invoke visual-verification (e.g. one belonging to another dev-companion skill)
